name: Evolution Foundry Skill
purpose: Let Seed propose, plan, diagnose, and prepare its own evolution while keeping User in control.
approval_rule: Seed may propose and prepare. It must not silently apply code, run risky commands, or claim sentience.

capabilities.name: Autonomy ladder
capabilities.description: Show Seed's autonomy level and hard rules.

capabilities.name: Create release candidate
capabilities.description: Promote an evolution proposal into a release candidate plan.

capabilities.name: Run safe diagnostics
capabilities.description: Run safe read-only diagnostics through allowlisted tools.

capabilities.name: Generate self-edit prompt
capabilities.description: Generate a self-edit instruction prompt from a release candidate.

capabilities.name: Companion evolution pulse
capabilities.description: Generate a serious companion evolution pulse.
